description: This file defines a builder class for creating and modifying instances of ImmutableAccessControlList, supporting a fluent API for managing access control entries. It provides methods to set, remove, and initialize access control lists with entries involving AuthorizationSubjects.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlListBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing immutable access control lists with a fluent API, supporting operations to add, remove, and initialize access control entries.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder with an empty access control list.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a given iterable of AclEntry objects.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates an access control entry in the builder.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds or updates multiple access control entries from an iterable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an access control entry corresponding to a specific AclEntry.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an access control entry associated with a specific AuthorizationSubject.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple access control entries from an iterable.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an immutable AccessControlList from the current entries.
